tasks.title: Stored functions crash server when used in select list and group by

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: 存储函数常量参数用于SELECT/GROUP BY崩溃，完整极小SQL可在目标探索。

test_spec.setup: 创建返回参数的f1(INT)函数和两行t1(i)。
test_spec.steps: 执行SELECT f1(1),COUNT(*) GROUP BY f1(1)，对照f1(i)分组。
test_spec.oracle: 常量组应返回一组count=2且不崩溃；列参数对照两组各1。
test_spec.target_applicability: 存储函数和GROUP BY存在于四个目标；目标影响未知可由运行确认。

comments.author: Mark Leith
comments.text:
Passing in the column from the t1 table is fine:

mysql> select f1(i), count(*) 
    -> from t1
    -> group by f1(i);
+-------+----------+
| f1(i) | count(*) |
+-------+----------+
|     1 |        1 | 
|     2 |        1 | 
+-------+----------+
2 rows in set (0.00 sec)
